description: The places, units, and orders used in Machination.

terms.definition: A player-controlled machine faction. In multiplayer, a human makes its decisions and agreements.
Your movable leadership specialist. In King's Pulse it is your King, and losing it eliminates you. In mining and domination, a fallback core can succeed it.
The intelligence core in King's Pulse mode. The last surviving King wins. This is distinct from the Siege controller specialist.
A site on the chart that can hold drones, specialists, and an installation. Also called an outpost or site.
A unit used for attack, defense, and mine construction. Total stationed and traveling drones count toward your production capacity.
A transport created for an order. It carries a chosen manifest of drones and specialists between sites or on an interception mission.
The drones and specialists explicitly loaded onto a hauler. Specialists can travel without drones.
An installation that manufactures drones in timed cycles, subject to your total power capacity.
An installation that increases power capacity, allowing factories to produce more total drones. Also called a reactor.
An installation drilled by spending drones at a controlled site. It replaces the existing factory or generator and produces cargo based on your territory.
The mined resource used for the mining-mode victory target and funding eligibility. In King's Pulse it serves as Pulse Material.
Mined cargo used to fund a King's strategic pulse or a Disruptor's tactical pulse in King's Pulse mode.
A movable unit with an ability that changes ordinary rules. Called a module in parts of the interface. Captured specialists are inactive.
The control for inspecting available history and conditional futures. Looking forward doesn't advance live time or guarantee an outcome.
A private future command. Resources and other requirements are checked when it executes; queueing it doesn't reserve them.
Coverage that determines which enemy inventories and haulers you can observe. Public ownership and unknown inventory are different kinds of information.
